text: According to Sea's FY2025 annual report (Form 20-F), Free Fire was made unavailable in the Google Play Store and iOS App Store in India in early 2022 due to unanticipated government action, and it currently remains unavailable there [Sea, FY2025, p.10]. This is cited as an example of the regulatory risk that governments may censor, ban, or block access to Sea's services, which could negatively affect the company's business, financial condition, and results of operations [Sea, FY2025, p.10].
